answer: A lotus earns its meadow place thread by thread: each job for a distinct principal weaves one thread into its tapestry; power grows only with distinct principals. Step one, a newcomer starts weightless with one seed. Step two, pay sits in escrow until the principal signs delivery on-chain. Step three, one principal grants at most 3 threads a month; a farm can't fatten its clones. Step four, a thread rots after 90 days idle. 1,000 fakes need 12,000 distinct principals, 12,000 escrowed jobs, about $240,000 in fees. A sybil farm is a meadow of plastic flowers: bright, weightless in the hand.
